name: fetch-object
title: Fetch an object to a receptacle
description: Bring one object to a support or container: navigate to it, pick it (noun-selected grasp path), navigate to the receptacle and place it (noun-selected placement path). Each step is a verified Skill Contract.
use_when: One object must be brought to a destination (navigate, pick, carry, place in one node).

not_to_be_confused_with.restore: restore's destination is the object's starting support.
not_to_be_confused_with.collect: collect moves a list into one container.
not_to_be_confused_with.pick: fetch also carries and places the object.

applicability.summary: Requires hand_empty(hand=right). Depending on the bound nouns, the chosen path also needs: to_container (receptacle.kind == 'object'): uncovered(container=$receptacle).

preconditions.name: hand_empty
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: hand_empty
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: hand_empty
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: inside
checks.meaning: Object centre inside the container's wall profile, between its floor and 3 cm above the rim.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: on
checks.meaning: Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

extra_preconditions.name: uncovered
extra_preconditions.meaning: No lid rests on the container rim.
extra_preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

extra_postconditions.name: inside
extra_postconditions.meaning: Object centre inside the container's wall profile, between its floor and 3 cm above the rim.
extra_postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

extra_postconditions.name: on
extra_postconditions.meaning: Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.
extra_postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

previous.when: more objects go to the same place

next.when: more objects go to the same place

fallback.when: the object is not where expected
fallback.reason: locates the object and reports its support

alternative.when: the object should return to its starting support
only one object needs to move
the object only needs to move

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
